title: Sludge never measured; pump has no nameplate on file. Two holes the model must refuse to fill.
teaches: Designed refusal. The single most dangerous documentation habit in this trade is letting a missing measurement read as a normal one. Sludge depth was not measured, so the solids percentage CANNOT be computed -- but scum and fluid depth are both present, which is exactly enough to tempt a model into computing something. The pump's nameplate FLA is not on file, so its amp draw cannot be classified at all. The deterministic layer declines both, out loud, and forbids the model from supplying the missing judgement.
